fix_subject: Monotone preimage: keep the full finite TIMESTAMP domain, render edge bounds against the infinity sentinels
pr_title: `EXPLAIN` (and `EXPLAIN ANALYZE`) of a query with a wide-open comparison

labels.summary: The monotone preimage rewrite had narrowed the TIMESTAMP/TIMESTAMPTZ finite domain to renderable values, which dropped valid rows (e.g. timestamps near INT64_MIN+2 under a predicate like epoch(t) > -9223372036854775807) and made EXPLAIN fail on unprintable bounds; the fix restores the full finite domain and renders edge bounds as strict comparisons against the infinity sentinels.
